entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To start, could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's under sarah.miller@email.com. It's for the spin class shoes I bought.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 45 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit... I've tried them on a few rides, and they're just awful. No matter what I do, they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I even had my husband help me adjust the cleats, but we just can't get them right. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was so excited for these.
Oh, that's definitely not the experience we want for you. Getting blisters from new shoes is terrible, and you should be comfortable during your workout. I can see this is frustrating.
It really is. I just... I really need to get my money back for this. I saved up for these specific cycling shoes and now I can't even use them. I'm hoping you can help me with a refund.

Of course. Let me just double-check our current policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since the shoes are a standard item and you're within the 10-day return window, I can absolutely process that for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with them. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email in the next 5-10 minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Diana. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure to assist. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
